idea-plugin.name: FastGoTo Bridge
idea-plugin.description:
Connect your editor to FastGoTo to open files, jump to code, find text, work with selections, and insert text from FastGoTo.

This plugin is free and requires the FastGoTo desktop application and its local connection service. FastGoTo offers free features and an optional VIP subscription.

The plugin connects to your local computer by default. Configure the connection and text sharing under Settings | Tools | Fast Idea Bridge. Text sharing is enabled by default and can be disabled while retaining file, caret, and selection-range information.
